data.title: Sing It Again Rod
data.notes:
Cocktail Glass shaped outer sleeve with same image on inner sleeve.

Printed inner sleeve:

 - Recorded and mixed at Mercury Recording Studio, U.S.A.
 - ℗ 1972 A&M / Ode Records* [B5]
 - ℗ 1972 Phonogram Inc.

Disc labels:
 - Mercury logo and black print on Chicago IBM Plaza background
 - ℗ 1972 Mercury Record Prod., Inc.
 - ℗ A&M / Ode Records* [B5]
 - Rim text: Manufactured and Distributed by Polydor Ltd. 6000 Cote De Liesse, St. Laurent, Quebec M4T 1E3 - Made In Canada

data.title: Between The Buttons
data.notes:
Has maroon labels with matrix numbers that appear without brackets.
Band name and album title are in all lower-case letters.
The font used for the title and artist is bold and broad. 
Side indications read ''Side 1'' and ''Side 2''.

Runouts feature scratched out portions represented by #.
The lone T in runouts is stamped upside-down in relation to the primary data.

identifiers.value: T LL3499 A #### A-XARL ### 7616-1E III V

data.title: Between The Buttons
data.notes:
Red labels - matrix numbers do not appear in brackets.
The font used for the title and artist is slim and elongated. Side indications read ''side one'' and ''side two''.

Runouts are etched, except for stamped & encircled-(MR) indicating a [l264380] pressing.

data.title: Between The Buttons
data.notes:
On the label the matrix numbers do not appear in brackets.
On label "Between the Buttons" is written in all capital letters. 
Side indications read ''Side 1'' and ''Side 2''. The "S" is capitalised verses other versions/releases
The "maroon/brownish" looking labels based on other web commentary appear to have double hand-etched matrix runouts.
May have Between The Buttons Promotional Sticker.

data.title: Between The Buttons
data.notes:
On the label the matrix numbers appear in parentheses.
The font used for the title and artist is slim and elongated. Side indications read ''one'' and ''two'' on a dark maroon London label.
Early issues came with promo sticker on album (see picture).
